trophies.guide: This is the platinum and it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, with no extra task of its own. Treat it as a checklist audit rather than a challenge: work through the Roadmap stages in order, clear the Missables view before the final mission, and use the Guide filters to hunt the last few counters. If this has not popped, filter the tracker to Unearned and something in that short list is the real blocker. There is no shortcut and no separate save is needed for this trophy itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies
Filter the Guide to Unearned to find any leftovers
Clear missables before finishing the final mission
Let the platinum unlock automatically

trophies.guide: Complete the named mission Gone Fishing, which the starter guide identifies as the opening mission. Simply follow the story markers from a new game, learn the basic movement, driving and interaction prompts as they are introduced, and do not skip the tutorial beats. Because it is the opener, there is no preparation, money or equipment needed beforehand. If you are replaying for cleanup, start from the earliest save you have rather than hunting for a late-game trigger.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Start the story and follow the opening markers
Complete the Gone Fishing objectives as prompted
Finish the mission to unlock the trophy

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission that belongs to Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter conclusion. Play naturally on your first run, keep a manual save at the start of each new chapter, and avoid spending long sessions on side content until the chapter break gives you a clean checkpoint. No optional collectible or activity is described as part of this trophy, so do not delay the chapter for grind work. The chapter save habit you build here protects every later strand final as well.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Play through all Chapter 1 story missions
Save manually at the chapter start
Complete the chapter finale

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in full, continuing directly from your Chapter 1 clear save. Keep following main markers only if you want a clean story-first run, and make a fresh manual save before the chapter finale so a bad outcome never costs you the whole chapter. The censored title is reproduced exactly as it appears in the official list and needs no decoding to progress. Nothing in the official description ties this chapter to an optional counter, so focus on mission completion.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Continue the story into Chapter 2
Complete all Chapter 2 missions
Save before the finale and finish the chapter

trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 3 to its conclusion for this story trophy. By this point the map and systems should be opening up, so resist the urge to chase every activity marker mid-chapter and instead bank a manual save at each chapter boundary. If a mission introduces a new mechanic, practise it briefly because later trophies reuse driving, shooting and wanted-level skills heavily. Completion of the chapter itself is the only stated requirement.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Enter Chapter 3 from your Chapter 2 save
Complete all Chapter 3 story missions
Finish the chapter finale

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last numbered chapter named in the official list before the separate final mission trophy. Keep your chapter-boundary save routine, and before starting the finale check the Missables view for any strand that is about to close off. The description gives no optional requirement, so story completion alone earns it. Treat the end of this chapter as your main decision point for whether to pause the story and clean up side strands.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Complete all Chapter 4 story missions
Check missables before the chapter finale
Finish Chapter 4 and save separately afterwards

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission to earn this gold trophy. Before you start it, make a separate manual save, finish or secure any strand finals you care about, and do the partner trophies while your partner is still available in free roam. Go in stocked and with your preferred vehicles and weapons ready, because finales in this series tend to chain several set pieces without a free-roam break. After the credits, keep both your pre-finale and post-game saves so cleanup can use whichever state suits a leftover trophy.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Save manually in a separate slot before the finale
Clear or secure missable strands and partner trophies
Stock up and complete the final mission

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run when it appears on the main story path. Follow its markers and objective prompts in order, and do not leave the mission area mid-task or the attempt may need to be restarted from its checkpoint. No optional work is named in the description, so a normal story-first playthrough earns this without extra preparation. If you missed noting it, check your earned state after each named mission rather than assuming chapter completion covers it.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Start Breakfast Run from the story markers
Complete each objective in order
Finish the mission

trophies.guide: Complete the named mission The Cartel Heist as part of the story. Heist-style missions reward patience: move with the objective prompts, stay with your crew where the mission expects it, and be ready for an escape segment with a wanted level afterwards. Prepare beforehand only in the general sense, with health, armour and a reliable vehicle available if the mission allows free preparation. Finishing the heist itself is the sole stated condition.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Start The Cartel Heist from the story path
Complete the heist objectives and escape segment
Finish the mission

trophies.guide: Complete the named mission Child's Play during the story. Follow the mission markers and complete each staged objective, staying in the area the mission defines until it formally ends. The official description adds no optional condition, collectible or performance target, so a standard completion is enough. Keep your chapter save habit so you can return to a pre-mission state if you want to replay a choice or a set piece.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Start Child's Play when it appears
Complete all staged objectives
Finish the mission

trophies.guide: Complete the named mission Headliners on the story path. Play it as a normal main mission, following markers and prompts to the end, and do not abandon the sequence midway for free-roam activities. Nothing optional is named in the official description, so no side preparation is required beyond arriving healthy and equipped. The trophy title is stylised in the official list and is reproduced here exactly as listed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Start Headliners from the story markers
Complete its objectives in sequence
Finish the mission

trophies.guide: Complete the named mission VCIA Takedown, set around VCIA as its name and the related airport trophy suggest. Follow the takedown objectives in order and be ready for the location to become chaotic, keeping an escape route in mind for any wanted-level segment. While you are in this location for the story, note the separate Catch Me If You Can trophy, which also concerns an unscheduled departure at VCIA and may share this window. Finishing the mission itself earns this trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Start VCIA Takedown on the story path
Complete the takedown objectives
Finish the mission and note the VCIA departure trophy

trophies.guide: Complete the named mission Operation Savage Glory during the story. Approach it as a set-piece operation: follow the briefing prompts, stick to the staged objectives, and expect the mission to move you between locations or roles without free-roam detours. No medal, time or optional condition is stated, so completion alone is sufficient. Save before starting it if you like to keep a clean pre-mission restore point for every named operation.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Start Operation Savage Glory
Complete each operation objective in order
Finish the mission

trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent game completion, the single biggest commitment in this list and the reason the roadmap has a dedicated stage for it. Work from the in-game completion checklist if one is shown, clearing story, strands, activities, collectibles and exploration in small batches rather than leaving everything to the end. Many other trophies in this list overlap with typical 100 percent requirements, so earning them as you go shortens this final push considerably. Keep a written or tracker-based note of categories that stall below their expected percentage, because the last missing percent is usually one overlooked activity type.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); method modelled on GTA V's 100% checklist structure (Rockstar Games, 2013)
steps: Finish the story and all strand finals
Clear activities, collectibles and exploration categories
Track the completion percentage after each batch
Hunt the final missing category until 100 percent registers

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts, a long counter that rewards steady progress over brute-force grinding. Learn what the game counts as a stunt early, weave stunt opportunities into normal travel instead of driving past them, and keep sessions varied by working a district at a time. If the counter supports repeatable locations, a short repeatable route is efficient, but do not assume repeats count until you see the total move. Pace this alongside exploration so the 250 total arrives naturally well before the cleanup stage.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Learn what registers as a completed stunt
Work district by district during normal travel
Check the counter regularly and finish the remainder in Stage 3

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once, with the starter data noting nine activity types in total. This is a sampler trophy: start one activity of every type at least once, even if you do not finish or medal it, and tick types off in the tracker as you go. It is best done early in the 100 percent push because it reveals which activity families the longer trophies will ask you to master. If a type has not registered, actually begin its event rather than merely visiting its location.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: List the activity types you have started
Start one activity of each remaining type
Confirm all types have been tried at least once

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge, noted in the starter data as 42 challenges. Learn each weapon category on its bronze and silver attempts first, memorise target patterns, and only chase gold once your accuracy routine is consistent for that weapon. Short, focused sessions per weapon type beat one exhausted marathon, and accuracy almost always matters more than raw speed unless a challenge states otherwise. Track golds per weapon so the last few missing challenges are obvious.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Unlock and attempt every Shooting Range challenge
Learn patterns per weapon category
Replay each challenge until it reaches gold
Verify all challenges show gold

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location, noted as 14 locations in the starter data. Visit each race start, learn its gate order on a first attempt, then replay immediately while the route is fresh in memory for the win. Drone handling rewards smooth, early turns over maximum throttle in tight sections, so ease off before dense gate clusters. Keep a location checklist, because a race you have entered but not won looks identical on the map to a finished one.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location
Learn the gate route on a first run
Replay for the win and tick the location off

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, so variety matters more than replaying one easy event twenty times. Bring a suitable, well-maintained vehicle for each race class, learn a course on the first attempt, and target wins on the courses that suit your driving rather than fighting the hardest events first. Mark each distinct race you have won, because the word different in the description is the trap here. This pairs naturally with exploration and stunt work between race locations.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Enter races across different locations and classes
Win a race and record which one it was
Repeat with new races until 20 distinct wins register

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge, a head-to-head activity result rather than a simple participation trophy. Practise the fishing mechanics in free fishing first so casting, hooking and reeling are second nature before you accept the challenge. Use the best tackle the game allows you to bring and stay patient on larger fish instead of forcing the reel and losing them. If you lose, re-challenge promptly while the spot and conditions are familiar rather than treating it as a one-time event, unless the game itself says otherwise.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Practise fishing mechanics outside the challenge
Accept Cal's fishing challenge
Out-fish Cal to win the challenge

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Find an arcade cabinet or machine, start a game, and see it through to its actual completion screen rather than quitting after a single round or credit. Pick the shortest or simplest game available if several are offered, because the description asks for completion, not a high score. This is one of the quickest trophies in the list once you know where a playable machine is.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Find a playable arcade game
Start the game and play to its end
Reach its completion screen

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's strand, working through each of Andy's earlier missions as they appear so the finale unlocks. Stranger and contact strands are easy to leave half-finished while the main story pulls you forward, so check Andy's strand before each chapter finale. Keep a manual save before starting the final mission itself and never overwrite your only save afterwards until the trophy registers. Finishing Andy's arc is also one strand toward the eight-strand Strangers and Freaks silver.
trophies.missable_note: Strand final that can be left unfinished if you rush the story; secure it before the final mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Complete Andy's strand missions in order
Save manually before the final mission
Complete Andy's final mission

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's strand by following Kenton's missions through to their conclusion. As with every named contact, clear the strand step by step instead of expecting the finale to appear on its own, and check its availability before chapter endings. Save in a separate slot before the finale so a skipped or failed ending never costs you the strand. This completion also counts toward the eight strands needed for Strangers and Freaks.
trophies.missable_note: Strand final that can be skipped if the strand is not followed to its end before the story closes.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Work through Kenton's strand missions
Save before the final mission
Complete Kenton's final mission

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's strand, progressing Billy's missions in order until the finale is offered. Keep Billy's strand on your Stage 2 checklist and do not let the main story outpace it, because strand finals are the classic quiet missable in open-world games of this kind. Make a separate save before the last mission and confirm the trophy pops before overwriting anything. The completion feeds the eight-strand total for Strangers and Freaks as well.
trophies.missable_note: Strand final that can be left behind if Billy's strand is not finished before late-story beats.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Complete Billy's earlier strand missions
Save separately before the finale
Complete Billy's final mission

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers across Leonida, which in practice means finishing the named strands such as Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone plus enough additional strands to reach eight. A strand only counts when it is completed, not merely started, so track strands by their final missions rather than by first contact. Work this in Stage 2 as its own campaign, sweeping the map region by region. Keep pre-finale saves for every strand, because this silver is only as safe as its weakest individual strand.
trophies.missable_note: Requires completing 8 strands; any strand left unfinished before its window closes puts this silver at risk.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18); method modelled on GTA V's Strangers and Freaks structure (Rockstar Games, 2013)
steps: Start stranger strands as they appear across Leonida
Finish each strand through its final mission
Count completed strands until you reach 8

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's strand by playing Randy's missions through in sequence until the finale unlocks. Treat Randy's arc as Stage 2 work, check it before chapter finales, and save separately before the last mission. Do not assume a strand final stays available forever just because its earlier missions did. Finishing Randy also moves your completed-strand count toward the Strangers and Freaks silver.
trophies.missable_note: Strand final that can be skipped if Randy's strand is not completed before the story ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Complete Randy's strand missions in order
Save before the final mission
Complete Randy's final mission

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's strand, following Tyrone's missions to their conclusion in Stage 2. Keep the strand moving whenever a new Tyrone marker appears instead of batching everything to the very end of the game. Save in a fresh slot before the finale and verify the trophy registers before you overwrite that save with post-finale progress. This is another of the strand completions counted by Strangers and Freaks.
trophies.missable_note: Strand final that can be missed if Tyrone's strand is left unfinished into the endgame.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Progress Tyrone's strand missions
Save separately before the finale
Complete Tyrone's final mission

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida, noted as 18 spots in the starter data. Interact with each spot fully so the meditation actually registers, and keep a simple region-by-region list because visited and completed spots are easy to confuse on a busy map. Pair the sweep with general exploration for The Goodtime State so you are not crossing the state twice for two trophies. If your count stalls near the end, revisit spots in regions you only passed through during the story.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Find meditation spots region by region
Complete the meditation interaction at each one
Tick off all spots until every one has registered

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal requested by Bret and complete that hunt successfully. Because the description singles out a unique animal rather than a species count, treat the hunt as a specific encounter: prepare your equipment, follow Bret's lead or briefing, and save before you set out. If the hunt can be failed or the animal can escape, a pre-hunt save is your insurance for a clean retry. Confirm the trophy registers as part of Bret's request, not as a free-roam hunt of a similar animal.
trophies.missable_note: A single unique-animal hunt for a named contact; save before it in case the encounter is one-time or failable.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Take Bret's unique-animal hunt request
Save before setting out
Track and hunt the unique animal successfully

trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets, which means finishing sets card by card rather than collecting a loose total across many sets. Focus on one set at a time, sweep its likely locations methodically, and use any in-game collection page to identify the exact missing cards in a nearly finished set. Partial sets give no credit here, so a disciplined set-by-set approach is far more efficient than opportunistic grabbing. Expect this to be a Stage 4 project that overlaps with full-map exploration.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Choose one card set and collect all its cards
Complete a second set the same way
Complete a third set and verify the trophy

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK action at 100 different locations, a pure coverage counter that rewards systematic travel. Learn exactly what interaction counts as WAiNK It early, then apply it whenever you arrive somewhere genuinely new rather than repeating one convenient spot. District-by-district sweeps alongside exploration, cards and meditation spots make the 100 total arrive without a dedicated grind. Keep an eye on the counter so you know whether repeats count or only fresh locations move it.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Learn the WAiNK interaction and confirm it registers
Use it at new locations as you explore
Sweep remaining districts until 100 locations register

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges of the game's challenge system, whatever categories it offers. Sample challenges from several categories early so you can favour the types you finish fastest, and batch short challenges together in single sessions for momentum. This is a count trophy, not a mastery trophy, unless a challenge itself states a target, so breadth beats perfection. It belongs in Stage 4 alongside the other counters, where leftover totals can be ground out deliberately.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Open the challenges list and sample several types
Complete challenges in batches
Continue until 50 completions register

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, build a four-star wanted level, then lose it completely and escape the heat together. Do this in free roam while your partner is available, in an area with good escape routes such as alleys, tunnels or off-road breaks in line of sight, and keep a fast vehicle ready. The key details are the exact star count and your partner's presence, so check both before you start the escape. If the attempt fails, it is cheap to retry, but only while the partner is around, which is why this should not be left to post-game uncertainty.
trophies.missable_note: Partner-dependent; do it while your partner is available in free roam rather than after late-story changes.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Be in free roam with your partner present
Raise your wanted level to exactly 4 stars
Break line of sight and lose the wanted level fully

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner, without your wanted level fully clearing between them. Plan a tight route of three nearby shops beforehand, use one fast vehicle for the whole chain, and move directly from till to till so the heat never drops off. Your partner must be with you for the sequence, so set this up in free roam while the partner is available. A failed chain costs only a few minutes, but scout the route once without robbing so the real attempt is clean.
trophies.missable_note: Partner-dependent chain; complete it while your partner is around instead of relying on post-game availability.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Scout three nearby shops and a driving route
Start the chain with your partner present
Rob all three in sequence without losing your wanted level

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles, which in practice means getting in, or otherwise registering, vehicles you have not encountered before. Vary where you travel, because each district and activity tends to spawn its own slice of the vehicle pool, and make a habit of hopping into unfamiliar parked cars rather than always returning to your own. Rare and activity-specific vehicles are the usual tail of this counter, so races, missions and wealthier districts are worth extra attention late on. The total should grow steadily if you stay curious from the first hours.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Enter unfamiliar vehicles whenever you see them
Explore different districts for different spawns
Hunt rare vehicle types until 100 are discovered

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single activation of Combat Focus. Set the attempt up rather than hoping it happens naturally: find a group of at least five enemies, position yourself with clear sight lines to all of them, top up health and ammo, then trigger Combat Focus and work target to target without hesitation. A mission or operation with a clustered group is the most reliable stage for this. If you fall one short, reposition and retry on the next cluster instead of wasting the ability on scattered enemies.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Find a cluster of at least 5 enemies
Position with clear sight lines and full supplies
Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 before it ends

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the location also featured in the VCIA Takedown mission. The wording suggests leaving by an unauthorised or unexpected means, most plausibly taking off in an aircraft or vehicle you were not scheduled to depart in, so experiment at the location with that reading in mind. Try it while the story takes you to VCIA, and save beforehand so experiments cost nothing. This reading is an inference from the wording, because the official description gives no method, only the place and the idea of an unscheduled departure.
trophies.missable_note: Tied to a specific location and possibly to the VCIA story window; attempt it while VCIA is open to you in the story.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Save before experimenting at VCIA
Look for an unauthorised aircraft or vehicle departure
Depart VCIA by that unscheduled means

trophies.guide: This description is deliberately cryptic, offering only a pun: it is hot inside these Rhinos, and a Rhino in this series' vocabulary is a tank. The most reasonable interpretation, labelled here as an inference, is that the trophy involves a Rhino tank, most likely entering, driving or surviving time inside one, possibly in hot conditions or under fire. When you first gain access to a Rhino, save, get in, drive it, use its weapon and spend some time in it to cover the plausible triggers. Do not over-invest in exotic theories until the simple tank interactions have all been tried.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Find or gain access to a Rhino tank
Save, then enter and drive the Rhino
Spend time in it and use its systems to cover likely triggers

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store completely without being detected, so stealth preparation is the whole trophy. Scout the store layout, entry and exit in advance, approach at a quiet moment if the game models one, and avoid any action that raises an alarm or a wanted level before the robbery is done. If detection can come from cameras, witnesses or noise, deal with each source the game gives you tools for rather than rushing the till. Save outside the store so a spotted attempt can be retried cleanly in seconds.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Scout a jewelry store and save outside it
Enter and rob it while avoiding detection
Leave with the take and no detection registered

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one, making this a repeatable crime routine rather than a single heist. Build a reliable pattern: scout the vault location, plan the getaway vehicle and route before you start, complete the robbery, and fully escape before counting it and moving to the next. Five successful escapes are required, so a robbery where you are caught should be assumed not to count. Vary locations if a single bank stops cooperating, and bank your earnings between attempts.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Scout a bank vault and plan an escape route
Rob the vault and escape completely
Repeat until 5 vault robberies with escapes register

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armoured truck and escape with the proceeds. When you spot or are alerted to a truck, prepare before engaging: a sturdy vehicle, full health and a planned escape route matter more than firepower once the robbery starts. Complete the robbery quickly, take the money, and focus entirely on losing any wanted level rather than fighting a prolonged battle. One clean robbery and escape is all the description asks for.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Locate an armored truck and prepare an escape route
Rob the truck and take the proceeds
Escape and lose any wanted level

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida, noted in the starter data as 52 areas. Exploration registers by entering areas, so methodically visit every district, island, back road and interior region the map contains rather than only following mission routes. Work with the map in a grid or region sweep during Stage 3, and combine the sweep with meditation spots, cards and WAiNK locations to avoid repeat journeys. The last few percent are usually small or awkward areas, so compare your map carefully against the region list when the total stalls.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Travel region by region across the whole map
Enter every distinct area, including outlying spots
Check for unvisited areas until all of Leonida is explored

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang, noted as nine gangs in the starter data. Keep a gang-by-gang checklist, because robbing the same gang twice does not advance the part that matters, which is coverage. Learn which operations belong to which gang before you start a robbery spree, and vary your targets across territories. Escape after each robbery so it counts cleanly, then move to the next gang's territory.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Identify an illegal operation for each gang
Rob one operation per gang and escape
Tick gangs off until every gang has been robbed once

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach, a small, specific leisure interaction rather than a challenge. Go to Ocean Beach, find the bar, vendor or viewpoint spot that offers a cocktail, and use the drink interaction fully so it registers. If several venues line the beach, try the one with an open view of the water first, since the view is part of the wording. This is a pleasant two-minute trophy to grab during your first relaxed visit to the area.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Travel to Ocean Beach
Find a cocktail spot with a view
Order and enjoy the cocktail there

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in a vehicle, in the classic style the description jokes about. Enter a vehicle showroom, get into a car inside, and drive it out through the glass or showroom frontage rather than using a normal door on foot. Save before the attempt if the showroom visit is part of a mission sequence, so a failed exit costs nothing. If a particular showroom does not register, try another showroom and make sure you exit in the vehicle itself.
trophies.missable_note: A specific one-off style moment at a showroom; try it at the first showroom you visit in case the story window is the intended one.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom and save if in a sequence
Get into a vehicle inside the showroom
Drive out by smashing through the showroom frontage

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt and Associates bowling alley named in the description and complete the bowling interaction there, with the title nodding to a famous series tradition of bowling invitations. Find the alley, start a game or the specified activity, and follow through by finishing it rather than leaving after one throw. The apostrophe and name are reproduced from the official description, so search your map for that exact venue name. One completed visit should be all this light trophy requires.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
Start the bowling activity there
Complete the game or activity fully

trophies.guide: This description is deliberately cryptic, saying only that it concerns a partnership with mass appeal. The most reasonable interpretation, labelled here as an inference, is a partner-related milestone that many players will hit, such as a shared activity result, a joint record or a story beat where the partnership is publicly recognised. Cover the bases by doing the other partner trophies, playing shared activities with your partner, and watching for this to unlock during partnered play rather than solo grinding. If it pops during a specific partnered moment, note that moment in the tracker for other players.
trophies.missable_note: Cryptic and apparently partner-linked; prioritise partnered play while your partner is available in case it is tied to a story window.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Play activities and free roam with your partner
Complete the other partner trophies
Watch for this to unlock during a partnered milestone

trophies.guide: This trophy tracks choices made, with the starter guide noting that the platform tracks a count toward 500, even though the visible description stays vague. Treat it as a long counter rather than a hidden secret: make choices whenever the game offers them in dialogue, missions and free-roam decisions, and never skip an optional choice prompt if you can help it. The count should build naturally across a full playthrough plus 100 percent work, so check it in Stage 4 rather than worrying early. Because the description is terse, this reading follows the tracked count noted for the trophy and is presented as the working interpretation.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Take choice prompts whenever the game offers them
Avoid skipping optional decisions
Check the tracked count in Stage 4 and keep choosing until it completes

trophies.guide: This description is deliberately cryptic, offering only the saying that the second time is the charm. The most reasonable interpretation, labelled here as an inference, is that you must fail at something once and then succeed at the same thing on a retry, such as an activity, a challenge or a repeatable encounter. When you genuinely fail a repeatable activity, retry it immediately and succeed, and note whether the trophy registers, rather than deliberately failing story missions. Keep expectations modest and let retries you naturally make do the work before engineering failures.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Note repeatable activities you attempt
After a genuine failure, retry the same activity
Succeed on the retry and watch for the trophy

trophies.guide: This description is deliberately cryptic, reacting with surprise rather than explaining anything, in the style of a hidden Easter-egg trophy. The most reasonable interpretation, labelled here as an inference, is that you must witness a strange, unexplained event somewhere in Leonida, of the kind this series hides in remote places at odd hours. Explore thoroughly, investigate odd locations and rumours the world itself presents, and linger when something unusual begins rather than driving away. No location is stated in the official text, so any more specific claim would be invention, and this guide will not invent one.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Explore remote and unusual locations across Leonida
Investigate strange events when they occur
Witness the event fully until the trophy registers

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by, striking a pedestrian or enemy with a melee attack from a moving vehicle as you pass. Practise the timing on a quiet stretch first, lining up your speed and distance so the melee connects without stopping the vehicle or running the target over outright, because a plain collision is not a melee hit. A motorcycle or open vehicle may make the attack easier to land if the game allows it. One clean connection is all the description requires.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Equip a melee option usable from a vehicle
Line up a drive-by pass at moderate speed
Land the melee hit as you pass the target

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn 250,000 dollars in total by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts, a cumulative money-system total rather than a single payout. Unlock and use the laundering route whenever marked bills come into your hands from robberies and operations, instead of sitting on them or spending around the system. Keep the cycle running alongside Stage 5 crime work so the total builds steadily, and check your laundered earnings after each batch. Holding one huge stockpile for a single laundering session is riskier than regular, smaller cycles.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Unlock the marked-bill laundering route via your contacts
Launder marked bills regularly after crime work
Track the laundered total until it reaches $250,000

trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars in total across all shops, a cumulative spending counter that normal play advances constantly. Buy vehicles, weapons, clothing, services and property-related goods as you actually need them, and let the total accumulate rather than wasting money on junk early when cash is tight. By Stage 5, when garages and endgame purchases arrive, most players will be close, and any shortfall can be closed with useful purchases. Keep an eye on the total so you do not overspend pointlessly after it has already registered.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Spend normally across shops as you play
Make larger useful purchases in Stage 5
Check the total until $100,000 spent registers

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties, noted as eight garages in the starter data. Save your money with this list in mind, buy garages as their districts open up, and keep a simple checklist of owned versus available properties so the last un-bought garage is easy to find. This is a Stage 5 purchase project that pairs with the spending and laundering trophies, since the same money cycle funds all three. If one garage will not appear for purchase, progress the story or explore its district first, then check again.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Locate each garage property as districts open
Buy garages steadily and tick them off
Purchase the final garage to complete all 8

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app named in the description. Learn the registration interaction the first time the app is introduced, then register vehicles as you discover them so this finishes alongside the 100-vehicle discovery trophy. Ten registrations is a modest total, so there is no need to hunt rare vehicles for this one specifically; ordinary variety is enough. If a vehicle will not register, try a different vehicle class before assuming the counter is stuck.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official PS5 trophy description (PlayStation trophy list, 2026-11-18)
steps: Learn the Scooter Bros registration process
Register vehicles as you discover them
Continue until 10 vehicles are registered
